title: Model catalog onboarding: new-model badges, deprecation timeline, and pricing overlays
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design, produce, and deliver a compact set of onboarding and release-note visuals for the model catalog release that introduces three new models and documents two model deprecations. Assets include hero screenshots for the release notes, compact model tiles (desktop + mobile), contextual pricing overlays, an inline deprecation timeline scrubber, and animated quickstart GIFs (30s and 60s variants). The goal is clarity in the catalog to: 1) surface new models to returning users, 2) show deprecation timing and migration guidance, and 3) surface unit-cost impact via pricing overlays in the quickstart flow.
acceptance_criteria: Hero screenshot with new model banner exported in 3 sizes (1200x600, 1024x512, 640x320).
Compact tiles show model badge, key capabilities, and pricing callout; accessible color contrast meets AA.
Deprecation timeline scrubber component designed and prototyped in Figma with two states: active and collapsed.
Animated quickstart GIFs demonstrate signing up, selecting the new model, and toggling pricing overlays; GIFs under 8MB.
Exported assets uploaded to Drive, assets linked in release PR, and handoff doc posted to Confluence with copy snippets and alt text.
